execution_graph.second_stage_mechanism: PEB-walk + export hash resolution to find kernel32 APIs, then: (1) VirtualAlloc RWX, (2) copy 0x6AC bytes from shellcode offset 0x15, (3) decode with XOR+bswap loop (key from config block XOR 0x7845EA91), (4) load decoded PE in-memory (section copy, relocation fixup, import resolution via PEB walk), (5) call PE entry point
execution_graph.second_stage_entry: determined by PE header (ImageBase + AddressOfEntryPoint after relocation)
execution_graph.second_stage_source: embedded (encoded within shellcode at offset 0x15, also accessible via the original PE file overlay on disk)

payload_analysis.unpack_note: The encoded PE at offset 0x15 must be XOR+bswap decoded using the key from the config block. The decode function is at 0x4DA. The decoded PE will be a full 32-bit executable loaded and executed in-memory.
